frontend.implementation: unaltered original dataset.Generator torchaudio MelSpectrogram+AmplitudeToDB(power), center=True defaults; soundfile float32 PCM matches librosa load at native16k mono

limits: No universal tile/fill/seal/moisture detector trained or claimed.
